customers are more satisfied with service quality delivery through the Web site of the company with which they are doing business if the Web site is easy to use, easy to navigate, easy to understand, and has an attractive appearance.

service quality delivery is important to the success of companies that offer Web presences and that service quality delivery can be improved by focusing on the Web site's content, navigation, and design.

the development of a model that explains how service quality delivery through the Web is perceived by customers.
the service quality delivery through the Internet, the service quality of the Internet itself, and how the Internet can be used as a tool for improving service quality in the physical world.

there is a lack of conclusive evidence on the topic of service quality delivery through websites.
service quality delivery is important, and that it is a critical factor in Web site performance.
the service quality delivery through the Web is a very complex and multidimensional construct, and that it can be measured by using both objective and subjective measures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the literature on service quality delivery through web site has been growing and is beginning to provide a foundation for understanding this important topic.
the Web site as a medium for service delivery is a new frontier, with much to be learned about the process and its effects.
service quality delivery is important for online customer service, but it is not yet well understood.

service quality delivered through Web sites has been studied from a variety of perspectives.
the literature is in a nascent stage of development, and there is a need for more empirical studies to test the theoretical models.
